messages:
anita: addressed the review comments from earlier — updated retry/backoff defaults, added an env var override, and included a tiny smoke test. PTAL when you get a sec. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4123 :pray:

sam: awesome, thanks for the quick turnaround. quick q — did you keep the default backoff at 250ms or change it?

anita: left default at 250ms for safety, but added BACKOFF_MS env var and doc note in CHANGELOG. snippet: `BACKOFF_MS=250`

lucy: can you also add a short blurb in the release notes about the new env var so infra knows about tuning? one line is fine.

anita: done — added a single line under "runtime config" in the RELEASE_NOTES.md and linked it in the PR description.

sam: small nit: would prefer EXPONENTIAL_BASE=1.5 for smoother ramps vs 2.0. can you switch and push?

anita: switched to 1.5, re-ran the local smoke, all green. force-pushed a tiny commit. :white_check_mark:

sam: lgtm from my side. no need to squash, keep the history. :+1:

lucy: infra ok to canary once ops reserves slot. tagging ops: @ops — can you reserve the 22:00 UTC slot tonight?

ops: reserved 2026-03-20 22:00 UTC for canary, noted the PR link. good to go on our end.

deploy-bot: scheduled canary window for PR 4123 at 2026-03-20T22:00:00Z — deploy plan ready.

anita: thanks everyone — marking review comments as resolved in GitHub and will merge after canary passes. ping me if anything else pops up. :smiley: 

sam: thanks — will watch the canary and report regressions if any.

lucy: adding a one-line ops playbook note for how to revert this change if we see edge-case failures.

anita: appreciated — closing the loop here.
